blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Trisha Tubu’s journey with the Farm Fresh Foxies has finally brought her to the Premier Volleyball League Finals. A former Adamson one-and-done, Tubu took a leap of faith into the pros when Farm Fresh joined the league in 2023. She was part of the franchise’s early struggles, while individually thriving with five Conference Best Opposite Hitter awards and her first Season MVP in the 2025-26 campaign. Now, she has helped lead the Foxies to their first Finals appearance after they stunned twice-to-beat No. 1 seed and Nxled, 26-24, 25-16, 23-25, 17-25, 15-11, in their do-or-die semifinal match in the 2026 […]...
